summary: In this lesson, you will launch Mirage and open the solidification results used throughout the course. The 3dMesh_Sym_solid.CST file contains the casting temperature data, while the 3dMesh_Sym_solid.MLD file contains the mold temperature data. Both files must be saved in the same folder.
actions: Download the 3dMesh_Sym_solid.CST and 3dMesh_Sym_solid.MLD files and save them in the same folder.
In the main PoligonSoft window, click Mirage.
In the file selection window, open the folder containing the downloaded files.
Select 3dMesh_Sym_solid.CST and click Open. The 3dMesh_Sym_solid.MLD file must be located in the same folder. Otherwise, only the casting temperature data from the CST file will be loaded.
Wait until Mirage finishes loading the results.
Check that the model appears in the workspace and that the temperature results for both the casting and the mold are loaded.
expected: The solidification results will be loaded in Mirage. The model will appear in the workspace with the casting temperature data from the CST file and the mold temperature data from the MLD file.
